throughline.zh: 本週封裝測試、伺服器散熱與晶圓材料供應鏈陸續公布合作和建廠計畫，並出現高雄新測試廠工程、特氣合資與微電網營運進度。
throughline.en: This week has brought packaging and testing, rack-cooling and fab-material developments, followed by a Kaohsiung test factory project, specialty-gas venture and microgrid operating milestones.

title.zh: 封裝、晶圓材料與高階測試新工程
title.en: Packaging, fab materials and advanced-test construction

summary.zh: 本週景碩、矽品、旺矽與漢測先後公布新產能或設備測試合作，科林研發竹南技術中心已動土。11 月 19 日日月光旗下福雷新增仁武 J 高階測試基地規劃，工程預算與未來量產狀態已分開標示。
summary.en: Kinsus, SPIL, WinWay and Hermes reported capacity or testing developments, and Lam broke ground in Zhunan. On November 19 ASE subsidiary Forei added its Renwu J advanced-test project, with investment plans distinguished from qualified output.

title.zh: 機櫃電源、液冷與伺服器整機展示
title.en: Rack power, liquid cooling and server-system demonstrations

summary.zh: 技嘉、光寶科、貝爾威勒及 SC26 展出業者此前揭露伺服器機櫃與高功率冷卻進度。雙鴻 11 月 18 日公布已實現毛利率及 2027 年 ASIC 散熱展望，資本支出與出貨仍以實際公告為準。
summary.en: Gigabyte, Lite-On, Bellwether and SC26 exhibitors presented rack power and cooling developments. Auras added realized Q3 margins and prospective 2027 ASIC cooling guidance, with capex and shipments to be checked as separately reported.

title.zh: 記憶體供應、SSD 控制與工廠營運
title.en: Memory supply, SSD controllers and plant operations

summary.zh: 模組廠、大聯大與台灣光罩等企業本週披露記憶體供應及晶圓製程進度。偉詮電 11 月 19 日說明晶圓代工及封測報價變動與新安全認證，未公布明年新價格。
summary.en: Memory vendors, WPG and Taiwan Mask reported supply and process developments. Weltrend on November 19 discussed foundry and test cost changes plus software safety certification, without revealing 2027 prices.

title.zh: 製程感測、儲能 PCS 與工廠供電
title.en: Process sensors, PCS storage and factory power

summary.zh: 日月光感測器採購、燿華儲能工程與漢科廠務訂單已在本週發布。11 月 19 日銳澤簽署特氣合資協議，台塑新智能與立碁另公布微電網合作及已上線的太平島工程，嘉義綠能設備新廠亦動土。
summary.en: ASE sensor purchases, Unitech storage construction and Hanke facilities backlog were reported earlier. Rayzher added a gas venture, Formosa and Ledlink disclosed microgrid collaboration and a commissioned Taiping project, and an energy-equipment factory broke ground in Chiayi.

title.zh: 國際晶片管制、資本流向與終端製造
title.en: International chip controls, capital flows and end-use manufacturing

summary.zh: 經濟部投資核准與國際高階晶片管制已於本週前幾期報導，鴻海與 Sony 車載業務收購仍待交割。元太 11 月 18 日新公告疑似資訊系統遭攻擊，初步無重大營運影響，案件仍在調查。
summary.en: MOEA investment approvals, advanced-chip controls and Foxconn's proposed Sony camera acquisition were covered earlier. E Ink disclosed a suspected IT cyberattack November 18 with a preliminary no-material-impact assessment, pending investigation.
